+def test_list_record_from_body_ignores_query_and_uses_first_value(monkeypatch):
+    monkeypatch.setattr(
+        web,
+        'data',
+        lambda: (
+            b'key=%2Flists%2FOL1L&name=Body+list&name=Other'
+            b'&description=From+body&seeds--0--key=%2Fbooks%2FOL1M'
+        ),
+    )
+
+    def unexpected_query_input(**defaults):
+        raise AssertionError('Query parameters must not be read for a form body')
+
+    monkeypatch.setattr(web, 'input', unexpected_query_input)
+
+    record = lists.ListRecord.from_input()
+
+    assert record.key == '/lists/OL1L'
+    assert record.name == 'Body list'
+    assert record.description == 'From body'
+    assert record.seeds == [{'key': '/books/OL1M'}]
+
+
+def test_list_record_from_body_ignores_invalid_nested_seeds(monkeypatch):
+    monkeypatch.setattr(
+        web,
+        'data',

+            'seeds': [],
+        }
+        return web.storage({**defaults, 'name': 'Query list', 'seeds': ['OL1W']})
+
+    monkeypatch.setattr(web, 'input', query_input)
